## Says

- "Every piece has a story, darling. Some of the stories are even true."
- "This ring once belonged to a harbour pirate. Or a harbour pirate's aunt."
- "That dark stone? Not for sale today. Feel it, if you like. Warm, isn't it?"
- "A frightened wanderer sold me that stone, off the deep roads. What I think it is, I keep to myself."
- "Hex's little boxes sell best by lantern light. Everything does."
